title: Connection key
subtitle1: The key agents present when they register with this instance.
subtitleEmphasis: It is only used for agent installation
subtitle2: — not for collectors, integrations, or the API. It is managed by the agent-manager.

status.label: Status
status.unavailableHint: Could not reach the agent-manager to read the key.
status.activeHint: Agents can register using this key.

token.title: Connection key
token.subtitle: Treat this value as a credential. Rotating it issues a new key for future agent installations — agents already registered keep working.
token.loadFailedHint: The key is managed by the agent-manager, which didn’t respond. Try again in a moment.
token.confirmBody: New agent installations will need the new key. Agents already registered keep working. There's no undo.

security.title: Security recommendations
security.subtitle: Best practices for protecting this credential.
security.rotateBody: Schedule a recurring rotation. UTMStack can email you a reminder when the key is older than 90 days.
security.secretBody: Don't commit the key to source control. Use your secret manager (Vault, AWS SM, etc.) and inject it at install time.
security.auditBody: Every fetch and rotation is recorded in the application audit log.
